ActorTalk: It is my hope that all those receiving honors today will cherish this recognition and continue to strive for excellence,
inspire others through unwavering faith, conviction, and resolve.
Furthermore, the military has decided to confer the Medal of Highest Honor upon the individual
who contributed most decisively to this operation: the Gray Raven Commandant.
We shall now proceed with the medal presentation.
Please welcome—【kuroname】!
Commandant.
By official decree: Gray Raven Commandant 【kuroname】,
for outstanding performance and distinguished service during the F.O.S. Homecoming Campaign,
is hereby awarded the Medal of Highest Honor.
And for saving my students,
safeguarding the future of Babylonia itself, you have my thanks.
On behalf of the military command,
I express our deepest respect to every soldier who fought with valor
and served with selflessness in this campaign.
Though unknown dangers still await,
I am confident that nothing can halt our advance now.
Humanity will overcome the Punishing Virus
and reclaim our homeland—
our Earth!
Finally, let me conclude today's ceremony with these words:
—May peace
be with every child of Earth!
